glyphEdges.region: The reference's visible text boxes, widened by one pixel
glyphEdges.reason: Chromium places glyphs on whole pixels and GPUI at sub-pixel phases, so the anti-aliased edges of the same text differ; moved, missing or recoloured glyphs still count

composerGradientNoise.region: Visible dark composer sheen only, excluding text, caret, selection, icons, buttons, borders and corners.
composerGradientNoise.reason: Chromium dithers the premultiplied gradient in raster-tile coordinates; native alpha blending quantizes it differently. Only one-level RGB differences in blank gradient pixels are equivalent.

paintNoise.region: Exterior shadows of the composer and work-status card, plus visible chat-scroll-fade bands. Text, controls, images, icons and the full card/composer rectangles are excluded.
paintNoise.reason: Chromium and GPUI differ by up to two RGB levels in blur and gradient rasterization. Larger differences and geometry remain strict.
